sloka: अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे तस्मिन् प्राप्ते तुरंगमे ।सरय्वाः च उत्तरे तीरे राज्ञो यज्ञो अभ्यवर्तत ॥१-१४-१॥
transliteration: atha saṁvatsare pūrṇe tasmin prāpte turaṁgame ।sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre rājño yajño abhyavartata ॥1-14-1॥

translations.english: After completion of one year when the sacrificial horse had returned, the sacrifice by the king (Dasaratha) commenced on the northern bank of river Sarayu.
